objective: Research OBS source-capture method tradeoffs on the gaming PC for feeding the HIGHEST-QUALITY clean game feed to a capture card by PROJECTING the source fullscreen onto a 3rd HDMI output. Compare three source types: Display Capture (DXGI Desktop Duplication of the whole monitor), Game Capture (hooking the game's swapchain), and Window Capture. GOALS: (1) For 1080p, compare Display Capture vs Game Capture vs Window Capture for efficiency (CPU/GPU), captured color/contrast fidelity, and whether Display Capture brings unwanted content (desktop/taskbar/notifications/overlays/wallpaper) into the feed; whether Game Capture produces a clean game-only feed; cases where Display Capture is needed or where it FAILS (fullscreen-exclusive, HDR, DRM-protected video). (2) Whether Game Capture can be PROJECTED to a different physical HDMI output than the monitor the game plays on (multi-adapter behavior, the 'use a different adapter for capture' setting, multi-GPU laptop adapter selection). (3) Practical recommendation for the user, who CURRENTLY projects the Display Capture SOURCE: which source to switch to for best quality plus least overhead, and required OBS settings (disable 'capture cursor', monitor selection, multi-adapter mode, anti-cheat hook compatibility like Vanguard/EAC, OBS Run as Administrator, SLI/CrossFire). Cover fullscreen-exclusive vs borderless. CONCLUDE with a concrete recommended OBS source configuration for this exact use case, plus pros/cons of each method. Cite OBS docs/forums, Moonlight capture-card guide, r/OBS.
